caption: The drawing features a repeated geometric and botanical pattern arranged in a grid-like composition on a pale, off-white or light gray background. At the top, a row of five large, red and brown leaf motifs stretches horizontally, bordered above and below by dotted and diamond-shaped linear designs in red. The main composition is divided into rectangular sections by similar dashed, linear borders. Within these sections, there are alternating motifs: a stylized pineapple form with red accents and olive-green leaves, circular floral designs filled with red, petal-like shapes, and smaller green leaf clusters with berries. These motifs are distributed vertically and horizontally, creating a symmetrical, alternating pattern. The bottom edge of the drawing also features a linear decorative border with red circles and dotted lines. The entire artwork uses primarily red and greenish-brown tones, combined with the background’s lighter shade.
title: Stencilled Wall
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
